name: Malapert Massif
reason: Highland massif of anorthositic crust; nearest GLiM class pb

name: Marius Hills lava-tube pit

name: Arcadia Planitia
reason: Surface is an ice-rich regolith mantle over Amazonian volcanic plains (vb underneath)

name: Jezero crater
reason: Target is the river delta (fluvial sandstone/mudstone); crater floor is igneous (vb)

name: Gale crater
